title: Commentaries of Proclus on Euclid, Vol. 1
author: Proclus (Taylor trans)
description: The first volume of Proclus's commentary on Euclid in Thomas Taylor's translation. It examines the philosophical foundations of mathematics and the place of geometry within the Neoplatonic pursuit of knowledge.
